sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ban/-ben expresses being inside a place. Use -ban after back-vowel words and -ben after front-vowel words.

Build yourself a tiny reference pair and lean on it every time you hit a new noun: szoba → szobában, iskola → iskolában. When an unfamiliar word shows up, don’t reach for a memorized rule about which vowels count as ‘back’ — just ask which of your two anchor words it sounds more like, and copy its ending.
